title: FreeCam MITE
description: A mod that enables "freecam" astral projection.
body:
## What does this mod do?
You can press F6 in-game to enable FreeCam mode, and this hotkey can be changed.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/79ARw8M5/images/8e5da8fbf81ab5b1ab0ad3a5f42694f418d860c1.png)

When you are hiding in a shelter at night, you can also press F6 to observe the outside.

![Replace this with a description](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/79ARw8M5/images/1639fe4de1149c9de8f4f7eec6b87e36674f6c49.png)

## Notice
When in FreeCam mode, your character cannot move. Please make sure you are in a safe location before using it.
